        Youth Evangelism Training (Y.E.T.) Compassion was founded by Evangelist Gai Bol Luom. The ministry's work began in 2006 with grassroots missions in South Sudan, was registered as a Tennessee nonprofit in Nashville in 2025, and received IRS 501(c)(3) tax-exempt status in 2026.
      </p>
    </details>

    <details style="margin-bottom: 1rem; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 200ms ease;">

      <p style="font-family: Inter, sans-serif; margin-top: 1rem; line-height: 1.7; color: #5A5955; font-size: 0.95rem;">
        Youth Evangelism Training (Y.E.T.) Compassion is headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, where it was registered as a state nonprofit in 2025 and granted IRS 501(c)(3) tax-exempt status in 2026. We also have on-the-ground operations in South Sudan, led by Director David Gai Pandak.
      </p>
    </details>

    <details style="margin-bottom: 1rem; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 200ms ease;">

    <details style="margin-bottom: 0; padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; background-color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #D9D8D4; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 200ms ease;">
